name: travel-problem-radar-case-study
description: Case study, sample-data demo and daily live version for Travel Problem Radar

scripts.build: npm run build:demo && npm run build:live
scripts.build:site: rm -rf public && mkdir public && cp -r index.html demo live subscribe manage signin signup public/ && rm -rf public/demo/src public/live/src && mkdir -p public/legal && cp -r legal/privacy public/legal/ && node scripts/fill-plan.mjs public && node scripts/fill-legal.mjs public
scripts.test: node scripts/test-sweep.mjs && node scripts/test-subscriptions.mjs && node scripts/test-compare.mjs && node scripts/test-plan.mjs
